blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISPE 科學與風險基礎 C&Q 導入策略的六大準備步驟，以及「無需重複確效」原則對遺留系統的意義。
blocks.en: Understand the six preparation steps of the ISPE science- and risk-based C&Q implementation strategy, and what the "no need to repeat qualification" principle means for legacy systems.

blocks.zh: 掌握針對新系統、既有系統（小改動）、既有系統（重大改動）三種情境的不同 C&Q 導入路徑與文件要求。
blocks.en: Master the different C&Q implementation paths and documentation requirements for three scenarios: a new system, an existing system with a minor change, and an existing system with a major change.

blocks.zh: 了解 ISPE C&Q 方法與主要法規（FDA 21 CFR、EU GMP Annex 15、ICH Q8/Q9/Q10）之間的對應關係，掌握法規基礎。
blocks.en: Understand how the ISPE C&Q approach maps to the major regulations (FDA 21 CFR, EU GMP Annex 15, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10) and grasp the regulatory basis.

blocks.zh: 能夠規劃一個分階段的組織導入計畫，以促進高階管理層的支持與跨部門協作。
blocks.en: Be able to plan a phased organizational implementation that builds senior management support and cross-functional collaboration.

blocks.zh: 能將 ISPE 導入策略應用於 CDMO 情境，制定從傳統 V-Model 過渡至 ISPE 2nd Ed. 方法的實際步驟。
blocks.en: Be able to apply the ISPE implementation strategy in a CDMO setting and define practical steps for moving from the traditional V-Model to the ISPE 2nd Ed. approach.

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 章節摘要 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 第 14 章（策略導入）說明組織如何有效轉型至科學與風險基礎的 C&Q 流程。核心訊息是：採用本指引方法並不會使現有文件失效——確效文件代表系統在某一時間點的狀態，只要配合現有品質系統（變更管理、維護、校正、定期審查），現有文件仍可繼續使用。
blocks.en: Chapter 14 (Strategic Implementation) explains how an organization can transition effectively to a science- and risk-based C&Q process. The core message is that adopting the approach in this Guide does not invalidate existing documentation: qualification documents represent the state of a system at a point in time, and as long as they are supported by the existing quality systems (change management, maintenance, calibration, periodic review), they remain usable.

blocks.zh: Appendix 1（第 15 章）提供本指引與主要法規（EU GMP Annex 15、FDA Process Validation Guidance、ICH Q8/Q9/Q10）的對應，從法規角度確認 ISPE C&Q 方法的合規性基礎。本節末提供 Appendix 2–17 的概覽總表。
blocks.en: Appendix 1 (Chapter 15) maps this Guide to the major regulations (EU GMP Annex 15, FDA Process Validation Guidance, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10), confirming from a regulatory perspective that the ISPE C&Q approach is compliant. An overview table of Appendices 2-17 closes this section.

blocks.zh: 導讀與解析
blocks.en: Guided Reading and Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心原則：不需重複確效 (No Need to Repeat Qualification)
blocks.en: Core Principle: No Need to Repeat Qualification

blocks.zh: 這是第 14 章最重要的一句話，也是許多企業最擔心的問題：「採用 ISPE 新方法，是否意味著我過去做的 IQ/OQ/PQ 都要重做？」
blocks.en: This is the most important sentence in Chapter 14, and the question many companies worry about most: "If we adopt the new ISPE approach, do all the IQ/OQ/PQ work we did in the past have to be redone?"

blocks.zh: 答案是否定的。ISPE 明確指出：採用科學與風險基礎方法，並不會使現有確效文件失效。確效文件代表「系統在某一時間點的狀態快照」，只要配合現有的品質系統（變更管理、維護、校正、定期審查），現有文件仍可繼續作為系統適用性的有效證明。
blocks.en: The answer is no. ISPE states clearly that adopting a science- and risk-based approach does not invalidate existing qualification documents. Qualification documents are a "snapshot of the system at a point in time"; as long as they are supported by the existing quality systems (change management, maintenance, calibration, periodic review), they remain valid evidence of the system's suitability.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：高階贊助的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of Senior Sponsorship

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出，成功的轉型「往往需要高階贊助」，因為涉及眾多利害關係人。這不只是技術問題，更是組織變革管理（Change Management）的挑戰：
blocks.en: ISPE notes that a successful transition "often requires senior sponsorship" because many stakeholders are involved. This is not only a technical issue but an organizational change management challenge:

blocks.zh: 研發部門：需要提供科學與製程知識
blocks.en: R&D: must provide scientific and process knowledge

blocks.zh: 品質部門：需要接受不同的文件交付物
blocks.en: Quality: must accept different documentation deliverables

blocks.zh: 工程部門：需要按 GDocP 標準交付文件
blocks.en: Engineering: must deliver documentation to GDocP standards

blocks.zh: 系統負責人：需要接受訓練以執行必要審查
blocks.en: System owners: must be trained to carry out the required reviews

blocks.zh: 比喻：確效文件如同「體檢報告」
blocks.en: Analogy: Qualification Documents Are Like a Medical Check-up Report

blocks.zh: 把確效文件想像成體檢報告：去年的體檢報告不會因為今年有了新的體檢標準就「失效」。舊報告仍然記錄了當時的身體狀況。只要在此期間有持續的健康管理（維護、校正、定期審查），就可以認定系統仍處於受控狀態。
blocks.en: Think of qualification documents as a medical check-up report: last year's report does not become "invalid" just because new check-up standards exist this year. The old report still records your health at that time. As long as health management has continued in the meantime (maintenance, calibration, periodic review), the system can be considered to remain in a state of control.

blocks.zh: 新方法就像更好的體檢問卷——它幫助你更精準地找出關鍵指標（CDEs）並驗證它們，但並不要求你把所有舊報告全部推翻重做。
blocks.en: The new approach is like a better check-up questionnaire: it helps you identify the key indicators (CDEs) more precisely and verify them, but it does not require you to throw out and redo all the old reports.

blocks.zh: 六步驟準備框架
blocks.en: The Six-Step Preparation Framework

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出六個實施準備步驟，本質上是一個組織成熟度評估與計畫制定的框架：
blocks.en: ISPE proposes six implementation preparation steps, which are essentially a framework for assessing organizational maturity and developing a plan:

blocks.zh: 步驟 1：定義組織方法（客製化指引）
blocks.en: Step 1: Define the organizational approach (tailor the Guide)

blocks.zh: 步驟 2：評估組織成熟度（從四個部門角度）
blocks.en: Step 2: Assess organizational maturity (from the perspective of four functions)

blocks.zh: 步驟 3：制定導入計畫（含試點專案）
blocks.en: Step 3: Develop the implementation plan (including a pilot project)

blocks.zh: 步驟 4：建立支持性品質系統與 SOP
blocks.en: Step 4: Establish supporting quality systems and SOPs

blocks.zh: 步驟 5：對方法論進行員工培訓
blocks.en: Step 5: Train staff on the methodology

blocks.zh: 步驟 6：對具體程序進行員工培訓
blocks.en: Step 6: Train staff on the specific procedures

blocks.zh: 組織成熟度評估的四個維度
blocks.en: Four Dimensions of the Organizational Maturity Assessment

blocks.zh: 步驟 2 的組織成熟度評估要從四個部門同時審視，任何一個短板都會影響整體導入：
blocks.en: The Step 2 maturity assessment must look at four functions at the same time; a weakness in any one of them will affect the whole implementation:

blocks.zh: 研發/製程開發：科學知識是否有足夠的文件基礎？資訊傳遞通道是否順暢？
blocks.en: R&D / process development: Is scientific knowledge adequately documented? Do the channels for passing on information work smoothly?

blocks.zh: 品質部門：是否願意接受「不一樣的文件交付物」？這需要品質部門的思維轉變。
blocks.en: Quality: Is it willing to accept "different documentation deliverables"? This requires a change of mindset in the quality function.

blocks.zh: 工程部門：是否有足夠的 GDocP 文件能力？變更管理系統是否完善？
blocks.en: Engineering: Does it have sufficient GDocP documentation capability? Is the change management system sound?

blocks.zh: 系統負責人：是否具備足夠訓練以執行審查？
blocks.en: System owners: Are they adequately trained to carry out reviews?

blocks.zh: 評估結果決定轉型的「程度與速度」——這是非常務實的考量，允許不同成熟度的組織以不同步調推進。
blocks.en: The assessment result determines the "extent and pace" of the transition. This is a very practical consideration, allowing organizations at different maturity levels to move forward at different speeds.

blocks.zh: 試點專案（Pilot Project）的策略價值
blocks.en: The Strategic Value of a Pilot Project

blocks.zh: 步驟 3 特別強調「初始小規模概念驗證試點專案」的重要性。這如同軟體開發中的 MVP（最小可行產品）：
blocks.en: Step 3 places particular emphasis on an "initial small-scale proof-of-concept pilot project". This is like an MVP (minimum viable product) in software development:

blocks.zh: 在一個小型、低風險的系統上先行試跑
blocks.en: Trial run first on a small, low-risk system

blocks.zh: 找出組織特有的流程障礙
blocks.en: Identify process obstacles specific to your organization

blocks.zh: 獲得實際成果作為說服高階管理層的依據
blocks.en: Obtain real results as evidence to persuade senior management

blocks.zh: 培養內部「先行者」成為方法論的推廣者
blocks.en: Develop internal "early adopters" who become advocates of the methodology

blocks.zh: 建議選擇新購設備或下一個小型確效專案作為試點，而非從最複雜的關鍵系統開始。
blocks.en: We recommend choosing newly purchased equipment or the next small qualification project as the pilot, rather than starting with the most complex critical system.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：如何說服高階管理層？
blocks.en: Exercise: How Do You Persuade Senior Management?

blocks.zh: 如果您需要向公司高階管理層提案採用 ISPE 2nd Ed. 方法，您會如何建構商業論述？提示：
blocks.en: If you needed to propose adopting the ISPE 2nd Ed. approach to your company's senior management, how would you build the business case? Hints:

blocks.zh: 舊方法有哪些痛點（過度確效、文件冗余、成本過高）？
blocks.en: What are the pain points of the old approach (over-qualification, redundant documentation, excessive cost)?

blocks.zh: 新方法帶來哪些效益（聚焦關鍵、降低成本、符合稽查趨勢）？
blocks.en: What benefits does the new approach bring (focus on what is critical, lower cost, alignment with inspection trends)?

blocks.zh: 風險是什麼？如何降低風險（從試點專案開始）？
blocks.en: What are the risks, and how can they be reduced (start with a pilot project)?

blocks.zh: 三種導入情境
blocks.en: Three Implementation Scenarios

blocks.zh: ISPE 區分了三種情境，每種情境的導入路徑不同：
blocks.en: ISPE distinguishes three scenarios, each with a different implementation path:

blocks.zh: 新系統（New System）：最直接，沒有現有文件包袱，從一開始就全面使用新方法。
blocks.en: New system: The most straightforward; there is no legacy documentation, so the new approach is used in full from the start.

blocks.zh: 既有系統 + 小幅改動（Minor Change）：最常見，以現有文件為基礎，僅針對變更部分補充新方法要求。
blocks.en: Existing system + minor change: The most common; build on the existing documentation and add the new-approach requirements only for the changed portion.

blocks.zh: 既有系統 + 重大改動（Major Change）：需要更全面地審查現有確效文件，找出差距並補充確效。
blocks.en: Existing system + major change: Requires a more comprehensive review of the existing qualification documents to identify gaps and supplement the qualification.

blocks.zh: 核心策略：最大化利用現有文件，只在發現差距或系統發生變更時才補充。
blocks.en: Core strategy: make maximum use of existing documentation, and add to it only when gaps are found or the system changes.

blocks.zh: 「Champion」角色的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the "Champion" Role

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別提到「champion」（方法論推廣者/倡導者）這個角色。在組織轉型中，這個人至關重要：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically mentions the role of the "champion" (an advocate of the methodology). This person is critical in an organizational transition:

blocks.zh: 深入理解 ISPE C&Q 的概念與目標
blocks.en: Has a deep understanding of the concepts and objectives of ISPE C&Q

blocks.zh: 協助解決跨部門的阻力與誤解
blocks.en: Helps resolve cross-functional resistance and misunderstandings

blocks.zh: 作為試點專案的技術主導
blocks.en: Acts as technical lead for the pilot project

blocks.zh: 建立組織的內部能力
blocks.en: Builds the organization's internal capability

blocks.zh: 通常由資深工程師或品質保證人員擔任，最好曾接受 ISPE 培訓或有相關實際經驗。
blocks.en: This role is usually filled by a senior engineer or QA professional, ideally someone who has received ISPE training or has relevant practical experience.

blocks.zh: 遺留系統的決策樹
blocks.en: Decision Tree for Legacy Systems

blocks.zh: 面對遺留系統時，ISPE 提供了一個清晰的決策邏輯：
blocks.en: For legacy systems, ISPE provides a clear decision logic:

blocks.zh: 第一步：判斷系統是否有潛力影響產品品質？
blocks.en: Step one: Determine whether the system has the potential to impact product quality.

blocks.zh: 如否：重新分類（可能降為 Indirect/No Impact），按 Commissioning 處理，不需要確效。
blocks.en: If no: Reclassify (possibly down to Indirect/No Impact) and handle it through Commissioning; qualification is not required.

blocks.zh: 如是：需要確效 → 審查現有文件是否符合現行要求
blocks.en: If yes: Qualification is needed; review whether the existing documentation meets current requirements.

blocks.zh: 文件符合：現有文件繼續有效，配合現有品質系統維護
blocks.en: Documentation is adequate: The existing documentation remains valid and is maintained through the existing quality systems.

blocks.zh: 文件不符合：使用新方法確效，並補救已識別的差距
blocks.en: Documentation is not adequate: Qualify using the new approach and remediate the identified gaps.

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯避免了「一刀切」的重新確效，同時確保法規合規性。
blocks.en: This logic avoids a "one-size-fits-all" requalification while still ensuring regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: Table 14.1 解讀：三種情境比較
blocks.en: Interpreting Table 14.1: Comparing the Three Scenarios

blocks.zh: 這張表是第 14 章最核心的實務工具，清楚地說明了不同情境下的 C&Q 文件要求差異：
blocks.en: This table is the most important practical tool in Chapter 14, clearly showing how C&Q documentation requirements differ between scenarios:

blocks.zh: 新系統：全套文件均為「Required」——URS、SRA、DR/DQ、C&Q Plan、Test Plan、Testing、程序文件、最終報告
blocks.en: New system: The full document set is "Required": URS, SRA, DR/DQ, C&Q Plan, Test Plan, Testing, procedural documents, and final report

blocks.zh: 小幅改動：大部分內容可以整合進「變更控制（Change Control）」文件，不需要獨立的完整確效文件包
blocks.en: Minor change: Most of the content can be integrated into the change control documentation; a separate, complete qualification package is not needed

blocks.zh: 重大改動：需要補充審查——重點是確認現有確效文件已涵蓋基於風險識別的 CDEs，如有不足則補充
blocks.en: Major change: Supplementary review is needed; the focus is to confirm that the existing qualification documents already cover the risk-identified CDEs and to add to them where they do not

blocks.zh: 重大改動情境的關鍵動作：Gap Review
blocks.en: Key Action for Major Changes: Gap Review

blocks.zh: 對於重大改動（Major Change），Table 14.1 的 Testing 欄位特別強調：
blocks.en: For a major change, the Testing column of Table 14.1 places particular emphasis on the following:

blocks.zh: 審查現有確效文件，確認基於風險識別的 CDEs 已被測試
blocks.en: Review the existing qualification documents to confirm that the risk-identified CDEs have been tested

blocks.zh: 如有不足，補充額外測試
blocks.en: If there are shortfalls, add supplementary testing

blocks.zh: 審查 SOP，確認程序性控制措施已就位
blocks.en: Review SOPs to confirm that procedural controls are in place

blocks.zh: 如有需要，更新 SOP
blocks.en: Update SOPs if necessary

blocks.zh: 這種「差距審查（Gap Review）」方式比全面重做更有效率，也是 ISPE 推薦的遺留系統處理方式。
blocks.en: This "gap review" approach is more efficient than a complete redo and is the ISPE-recommended way of handling legacy systems.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：三類系統的分類處理策略
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Classification Strategy for Three Types of Systems

blocks.zh: 對於一家中型 CDMO，建議按以下方式將現有設備分類處理：
blocks.en: For a mid-sized CDMO, we recommend classifying and handling existing equipment as follows:

blocks.zh: A 類（新購設備）：全面導入 ISPE 2nd Ed. 方法，從 URS 開始即採用風險基礎分類與 SRA
blocks.en: Category A (newly purchased equipment): Fully adopt the ISPE 2nd Ed. approach, using risk-based classification and an SRA from the URS stage onward

blocks.zh: B 類（既有設備 + 計畫變更）：在下一次變更控制時，附帶執行「Gap Review」，審查是否有未被涵蓋的 CDEs
blocks.en: Category B (existing equipment + planned change): Perform a "gap review" alongside the next change control to check for CDEs that are not yet covered

blocks.zh: C 類（既有設備 + 無計畫變更）：在下一次定期審查（Periodic Review）時評估現有文件的充分性，記錄評估結論
blocks.en: Category C (existing equipment + no planned change): Assess the adequacy of the existing documentation at the next periodic review, and record the conclusion of the assessment

blocks.zh: 這種分類方式確保資源集中在最有價值的地方，同時逐步完成全廠系統的方法論轉型。
blocks.en: This classification keeps resources focused where they add the most value, while gradually completing the methodology transition across the whole site.

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 的作用：法規基礎的「對應表」
blocks.en: The Role of Appendix 1: A Regulatory "Cross-Reference Table"

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 逐章列出 ISPE C&Q 方法與主要法規的對應引用，其核心訊息是：ISPE C&Q 方法並非更寬鬆的替代品，而是法規期望的體現。
blocks.en: Appendix 1 lists, chapter by chapter, the references that map the ISPE C&Q approach to the major regulations. Its core message is: the ISPE C&Q approach is not a more lenient substitute, but an expression of regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: 這份對應表的戰略意義在於：當稽查員質疑新方法的合規性時，可以直接引用這些法規原文作為依據。
blocks.en: The strategic value of this cross-reference is that when an inspector questions the compliance of the new approach, you can cite the original regulatory text directly as your basis.

blocks.zh: 關鍵法規訊息解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Key Regulatory Messages

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 中有幾段引文特別值得注意：
blocks.en: Several quotations in Appendix 1 deserve particular attention:

blocks.zh: 「風險程度相稱原則」（ICH Q9）：品質風險管理的力度、正式程度和文件要求，應與風險程度相稱。這直接支持了 ISPE 的比例原則——低風險系統不需要過度確效。
blocks.en: "Commensurate with the level of risk" (ICH Q9): The effort, formality and documentation of quality risk management should be commensurate with the level of risk. This directly supports ISPE's principle of proportionality: low-risk systems do not need to be over-qualified.

blocks.zh: 「連續而非二元」（FDA 2011）：FDA 明確指出，關鍵性是一個「連續體」而非「非此即彼的二元狀態」。這為 CDEs 的風險分級提供了法規支持。
blocks.en: "A continuum, not binary" (FDA 2011): FDA states explicitly that criticality is a "continuum" rather than an "either/or binary state". This gives regulatory support to the risk grading of CDEs.

blocks.zh: 「高階管理層的支持」（FDA 2011）：FDA 直接在法規指引中提到，「專案計畫以及高階管理層的全力支持是成功的關鍵要素」。
blocks.en: "Senior management support" (FDA 2011): FDA states directly in its guidance that "project plans and the full support of senior management are key elements for success".

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規是地圖，ISPE 是導航
blocks.en: Analogy: Regulations Are the Map, ISPE Is the Navigation

blocks.zh: 把主要法規（FDA、EU GMP Annex 15、ICH）想像成「地圖」：它們說明了你需要到達的目的地（確保品質、管理風險、生命週期管理），但沒有詳細說明如何開車。
blocks.en: Think of the major regulations (FDA, EU GMP Annex 15, ICH) as a "map": they describe the destination you need to reach (ensuring quality, managing risk, lifecycle management) but do not explain in detail how to drive there.

blocks.zh: ISPE C&Q 指引就像「導航系統」：它根據地圖規劃出一條具體、高效的路線。Appendix 1 就是在確認這條路線確實通往法規要求的目的地，沒有走捷徑，也沒有繞遠路。
blocks.en: The ISPE C&Q Guide is like a "navigation system": based on the map, it plans a specific, efficient route. Appendix 1 confirms that this route does lead to the destination the regulations require, with no shortcuts and no detours.

blocks.zh: 法規授權：以風險決定 C&Q 的範圍與程度
blocks.en: Regulatory Authorization: Risk Determines the Scope and Extent of C&Q

blocks.zh: 第 14 章的法規基礎只有一段核心引文，但這段話實際上授權了整個 ISPE 方法論的核心邏輯：
blocks.en: The regulatory basis in Chapter 14 is only one core quotation, but it effectively authorizes the central logic of the entire ISPE methodology:

blocks.zh: 「確效的範圍與程度，應基於有正當理由且有文件記錄的風險評估。」
blocks.en: "The scope and extent of validation should be based on a justified and documented risk assessment."

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 不是所有系統都需要完整的 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: Not every system needs a full IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 不是所有測試都需要相同的嚴格程度
blocks.en: Not every test needs the same level of rigor

blocks.zh: 這不是在放寬標準——而是在更準確地將資源聚焦在真正重要的地方
blocks.en: This is not a relaxation of standards; it is a more accurate focusing of resources on what really matters

blocks.zh: 給稽查準備的核心論述
blocks.en: The Core Argument for Inspection Readiness

blocks.zh: 如果在 FDA 或 EMA 稽查中被質疑「為何你的確效文件與傳統 IQ/OQ/PQ 格式不同？」，正確的回應論述是：
blocks.en: If, during an FDA or EMA inspection, you are asked "why does your qualification documentation differ from the traditional IQ/OQ/PQ format?", the right response is:

blocks.zh: 我們遵循 EU GMP Annex 15（或 FDA Process Validation Guidance）的要求
blocks.en: We follow the requirements of EU GMP Annex 15 (or the FDA Process Validation Guidance)

blocks.zh: 法規明確要求以有文件記錄的風險評估來決定確效的範圍與程度
blocks.en: The regulations explicitly require that the scope and extent of validation be determined by a documented risk assessment

blocks.zh: 我們的方法（ISPE C&Q）正是該法規期望的體現
blocks.en: Our approach (ISPE C&Q) is precisely an expression of that regulatory expectation

blocks.zh: 我們的 SRA 文件（系統風險評估）就是「有正當理由且有文件記錄的風險評估」
blocks.en: Our SRA (system risk assessment) is the "justified and documented risk assessment"

blocks.zh: 這個論述將方法論的合法性建立在法規原文之上，而非僅依賴 ISPE 指引本身的權威性。
blocks.en: This argument grounds the legitimacy of the methodology in the regulatory text itself, rather than relying solely on the authority of the ISPE Guide.

blocks.zh: 附錄體系的整體架構
blocks.en: Overall Structure of the Appendices

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.5 的附錄體系（Appendix 1–17）提供了完整的「工具箱」，對應主體各章節：
blocks.en: The ISPE Vol. 5 appendices (Appendix 1-17) provide a complete "toolbox" that corresponds to the chapters of the main text:

blocks.zh: 法規依據類（App.1）：提供合規論述的法規引文基礎
blocks.en: Regulatory basis (App. 1): Provides the regulatory quotations that underpin the compliance argument

blocks.zh: 文件模板類（App.2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13）：可直接修改使用的 SOP 表格與模板
blocks.en: Document templates (App. 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 13): SOP forms and templates that can be adapted and used directly

blocks.zh: 參考清單類（App.4）：提供典型 Direct Impact 系統清單供參考
blocks.en: Reference lists (App. 4): Provides a list of typical Direct Impact systems for reference

blocks.zh: 成熟度評估類（App.14）：用於評估組織轉型準備度
blocks.en: Maturity assessment (App. 14): Used to assess the organization's readiness for transition

blocks.zh: 遺留系統專用類（App.15）：專門處理遺留系統確效問題
blocks.en: Legacy systems (App. 15): Dedicated to the qualification of legacy systems

blocks.zh: 術語定義類（App.17）：確保全組織使用一致的術語
blocks.en: Glossary (App. 17): Ensures consistent terminology across the organization

blocks.zh: 最重要的附錄：App.2（URS）與 App.5（SRA）
blocks.en: The Most Important Appendices: App. 2 (URS) and App. 5 (SRA)

blocks.zh: 從實務角度，新導入 ISPE 方法的組織最常使用的兩個附錄：
blocks.en: From a practical standpoint, these are the two appendices used most often by organizations newly adopting the ISPE approach:

blocks.zh: Appendix 2（URS 模板）：提供完整的 URS 文件格式，包含「合適」與「不合適」需求的範例說明，非常有教學價值。例如，純粹的工程規格（如 HMI 解析度）不應寫在 URS 中。
blocks.en: Appendix 2 (URS template): Provides a complete URS document format, including examples of "appropriate" and "inappropriate" requirements, which is of great teaching value. For example, purely engineering specifications (such as HMI resolution) should not be written into the URS.

blocks.zh: Appendix 5（SRA 模板）：系統風險評估是 ISPE 方法的核心工具，決定了哪些系統元件是 CDEs，進而決定確效測試的範圍。有了標準模板可以確保評估的一致性。
blocks.en: Appendix 5 (SRA template): The system risk assessment is the core tool of the ISPE approach; it determines which system components are CDEs and therefore the scope of qualification testing. A standard template ensures consistency of assessments.

blocks.zh: CDMO 導入路線圖：從零到全面導入的 12 個月計畫
blocks.en: CDMO Implementation Roadmap: A 12-Month Plan from Zero to Full Adoption

blocks.zh: 建議中型 CDMO 按以下時程推進 ISPE 2nd Ed. 導入：
blocks.en: We recommend that a mid-sized CDMO advance the ISPE 2nd Ed. implementation on the following timeline:

blocks.zh: 月 1-2：組織準備 — 指定 Champion、完成組織成熟度評估（App.14）、高階管理層簡報
blocks.en: Months 1-2: Organizational preparation: appoint a Champion, complete the organizational maturity assessment (App. 14), brief senior management

blocks.zh: 月 3-4：SOP 建立 — 依據本指引修訂確效主計畫（VMP）、制定系統分類 SOP、SRA SOP
blocks.en: Months 3-4: SOP development: revise the Validation Master Plan (VMP) in line with this Guide, and develop the system classification SOP and the SRA SOP

blocks.zh: 月 5-6：試點專案 — 選定一個新購設備，全程採用 ISPE 方法（URS → SRA → DR → C&Q）
blocks.en: Months 5-6: Pilot project: select one newly purchased item of equipment and apply the ISPE approach throughout (URS → SRA → DR → C&Q)

blocks.zh: 月 7-8：稽查準備 — 整理法規對應文件（App.1 引文）、培訓稽查應對話術
blocks.en: Months 7-8: Inspection readiness: compile the regulatory cross-reference documents (App. 1 quotations) and train staff in how to respond in inspections

blocks.zh: 月 9-12：全面推廣 — 對所有新系統採用新方法；對既有系統在下次 Periodic Review 或變更時按 Table 14.1 處理
blocks.en: Months 9-12: Full roll-out: use the new approach for all new systems; for existing systems, handle them per Table 14.1 at the next periodic review or change

blocks.zh: 附錄如同「標準套件」
blocks.en: The Appendices as a "Standard Toolkit"

blocks.zh: 把 ISPE 附錄體系想像成一個品質管理「標準套件」，類似 ISO 9001 的文件模板包。你不需要從頭發明文件格式，只需要按照組織需求客製化這些模板，再加上適當的版本控制與審核流程，即可建立符合 ISPE 標準的 C&Q 文件體系。
blocks.en: Think of the ISPE appendices as a quality management "standard toolkit", similar to a package of ISO 9001 document templates. You do not need to invent document formats from scratch; you only need to tailor the templates to your organization's needs, add appropriate version control and review processes, and you can build a C&Q documentation system that meets ISPE standards.

blocks.zh: 對於資源有限的中小型製造商或 CDMO，直接使用這些模板可以節省大量的文件開發時間，並確保符合業界最佳實踐。
blocks.en: For small and mid-sized manufacturers or CDMOs with limited resources, using these templates directly can save a great deal of document development time and ensure alignment with industry best practice.

blocks.zh: 完整學習旅程回顧
blocks.en: Review of the Complete Learning Journey

blocks.zh: 最終綜合應用練習
blocks.en: Final Integrated Exercise

blocks.zh: 假設您是一家 CDMO 的驗證部門主管，剛收到以下三個任務，請根據 Table 14.1 判斷各應採用哪種方法：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the head of validation at a CDMO and have just received the following three tasks. Based on Table 14.1, decide which approach applies to each:

blocks.zh: 公司新購入一台全自動灌裝機，尚未安裝。
blocks.en: The company has purchased a new fully automatic filling machine that has not yet been installed.

blocks.zh: 既有凍乾機（15 年前做過 IQ/OQ/PQ）需要更換一個冷凝器，屬於非設計變更的同規格替換。
blocks.en: An existing lyophilizer (IQ/OQ/PQ performed 15 years ago) needs a condenser replaced, as a like-for-like replacement with no design change.

blocks.zh: 既有 WFI 系統計畫擴建新的分配迴路，新增 3 個使用點。
blocks.en: An existing WFI system is planned to be expanded with a new distribution loop adding 3 points of use.

blocks.zh: 提示：情境 1 = 新系統；情境 2 = 小幅改動；情境 3 = 重大改動（重新評估 URS 和 SRA）。
blocks.en: Hint: Scenario 1 = new system; Scenario 2 = minor change; Scenario 3 = major change (re-evaluate the URS and SRA).

blocks.en: ISPE Vol. 5 Complete Learning Map

blocks.en: Having completed this section, you have mastered the full framework of ISPE Baseline Vol. 5:
